The problem

Banking engagement is reactive.

Mass campaigns convert under 3%. Dormancy is silent. Drop-offs go unseen until it's too late. The largest customer base in world banking is spoken to in segments — not as people.

Our vision

Every customer gets a personal AI relationship team.

Proactive, contextual, compliant — AURA turns SBI's scale into intimacy. AI that doesn't wait to be asked: it senses, reasons, and engages at life's moments that matter.

The agent swarm

Six specialists.
One relationship.

Each Digital Twin is surrounded by a swarm of specialised agents — sensing, inferring, checking, choosing, conversing and learning. Together they behave like a personal relationship team that never sleeps, never forgets, and never breaks a rule.

  • Human-in-the-loop override on every decision
  • Compliance embedded, not bolted on
  • Learns from every click, ignore and purchase

Sensor Agent

Streams every transaction, YONO tap, bureau refresh and branch note into the Twin — in real time.

1.2M signals/min

Life-Event Agent

Correlates patterns into life moments: a first home, a daughter's admission, a business scaling up.

91% event precision

Risk & Compliance Agent

RBI and DPDP guardrails live inside the loop — consent, suitability and human override on every action.

100% actions checked

Offer Agent

Selects one next-best-action per customer from the eligible product universe. Never a blast.

4× conversion

Conversation Agent

Writes in the customer's language and tone, at the moment they actually read — 22 languages deep.

22 languages

Feedback Agent

Every click, ignore or purchase flows back into memory. AURA gets smarter with each interaction.

continuous loop
